name: Gart Mistrunner
summary: At Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner guides novice tauren called by the Earth Mother. He teaches their first rites of nature magic on the Red Cloud Mesa.

sections.title: Mentor of the Red Cloud Mesa
sections.body: Gart Mistrunner watches over Camp Narache as the Shu'halo rekindle their ancient druidic path. New tauren druids are sent to him when they take their first steps on the Red Cloud Mesa, often with a note commending them to his care. Gart teaches them to commune with the natural world. They draw on nature's restorative power and Mu'sha's lunar radiance to heal allies and strike down threats to the land.

faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner trains druids at Camp Narache in the Red Cloud Mesa of Mulgore. He teaches novice tauren their first spells and rites.

faq.q: What spells does he teach newly awakened druids?
faq.answer: Gart teaches beginners essential nature abilities, including the healing spell Healing Touch and the offensive nature magic Moonfire.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Mistrunner clan?
faq.answer: Mistrunner is Gart's family name. No lore describes a Mistrunner tribe or says more about his kin; he is known as the druid trainer of Camp Narache.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, Gart Mistrunner is the first master to shape your communion with the wilds and the gifts of the Earth Mother.
As a tauren, you see Gart Mistrunner pass the Shu'halo's ancient druidic traditions to the youth of Camp Narache.
